entities.name: CoaBC bifunctional enzyme
observations: The 404-aa query matches reviewed Vibrio CoaBC proteins over 100% query coverage at 74–75% identity (strong homology support).
Catalyzes CoA-biosynthesis steps: phosphopantothenate–cysteine ligation (EC 6.3.2.5) and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation (EC 4.1.1.36).
Reference annotations report FMN and Mg2+ as cofactors.

entities.name: RHEA:19397
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC performs the second and third annotated steps of CoA biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate.
